stem: Which line of dialogue provides the best evidence that Lennie has low self-esteem?

options.label: A
options.text: Go on, George! Tell about what we're gonna have in the garden.

options.label: B
options.text: Furry ones, George. Like I seen at the fair in Sacramento.

options.label: C
options.text: That's it, that's it! Now tell how it is with us.

options.label: D
options.text: 'Cause I can jus' as well go away, George, and live in a cave.
